title: China Confirms AI Export Controls With Auto-Licensing for Open Source
summary:
Frontier artificial intelligence models and semiconductor designs are now subject to stricter trade rules after Beijing issued a revised catalogue of prohibited and restricted technologies. The Ministry of Commerce (MofCom) and Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) confirmed that exporters must obtain approval to release weights and source code for systems exceeding 2 trillion parameters or those ranking in the global top 10 for performance and usage. The restrictions expand to include chip stacking and networking, as well as AI agents that support at least 200 third-party tools with 90% accuracy and computing cluster technologies.

To support the growth of the domestic innovation ecosystem, MofCom introduced a "near automatic" licensing regime allowing open-source releases, overseas chip tape-outs, and joint research to proceed immediately upon filing. While APIs, software-as-a-service, and previously public open-source models remain exempt, exporters must register new overseas technology transfers effective immediately. The government is conducting public consultations on the draft proposal until Nov 15.

selectedTweets.text:
HOLY. China is moving to put 23 AI technologies under export controls, including large models, AI agents and computing clusters, as part of a sweeping proposal to ban exports of 14 technologies and restrict another 26.

The rules would ban technology for AI systems that autonomously generate or mutate malware, while AI-assisted vulnerability discovery and overseas deployment of restricted Chinese models would require approval.

APIs, apps, SaaS and already-public open-source technologies are exempt.

Exporters must begin registering covered overseas technology transfers today, before the final controls are adopted. Public consultation closes November 15.

selectedTweets.bestBit: registration requirement is effective immediately, with a public comment period over the next month
selectedTweets.text:
Huge: The Chinese government moves to place registration and licensing requirements on frontier AI model weights, chip designs, and other key AI technologies.

A registration requirement is effective immediately, with a public comment period over the next month before the more expansive regulations are finalized. 

The draft includes a range of prohibitions and licensing requirements that could shape the evolution of the Chinese AI ecosystem. It also provides simplified pathways for certain open-source releases and a range of excluded areas.

This is a major step and could give Beijing substantial new leverage over the global spread of Chinese AI. But there are lots of questions about the practical consequences:

—How much will model companies reshape the definitions, thresholds, and processes during the "consultation" period?

—What will firms actually start doing to comply in the coming days?

—Will implementation materially restrict the global spread of Chinese models, or chiefly give Beijing greater visibility into—and discretion over—how they spread?

MofCom said they will have a near auto licensing regime for open-source AI that allows more rapid release it seems?

selectedTweets.text:
完蛋了…..以后中国开源模型只能开源小参数的模型了….

商务部科技部就修订《中国禁止出口限制出口技术目录》征求意见，为期一个月，涉及人工智能（大模型、智能体、算力集群、信息处理等23项）生物医药、光伏3个领域。

1️⃣限制出口AI大模型：超过10^26计算量、或2T参数、或公开评估排名全球前10的大模型。

2️⃣限制出口智能体Agent：工具调用与系统操作技术，支持集成的第三方工具数量≥200个，工具选择准确率≥90%，且在需要调用3种及以上工具协同完成任务场景中，端到端任务平均成功率≥90%；自主规划与任务分解技术，可将自然语言指令自动拆解≥20步可执行子任务链，子任务分解精度≥80%，且子任务平均成功率≥90%；标准博弈基准超过90%的人类的博弈决策技术；得分75%以上的AI辅助漏洞挖掘技术。

限制出口算力集群技术：片间互联技术、分布式训练容错技术、通信调度技术、异构集群高效推理与调度。

征求意见期间，出口相关技术需向商务部填报登记表。已通过开源、发表学术论文等方式进入公共领域的技术，不纳入管理范围。
（中国商务部）
